প্রশ্ন প্রণয়নে:
জনাব সালেহ আহমেদ
৩৫তম বিসিএস (সাধারণ শিক্ষা)
প্রভাষক, ইংরেজি বিভাগ।
মৌলভীবাজার সরকারি কলেজ।

English Wizard.question: ১) Shubhash not only told a lie but also tried to justify it. (Make it simple)
English Wizard.option1: ক) In spite of telling a lie, Shubhash also tried to justify it.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Besides telling a lie, he also tried to justify it.
English Wizard.option3: গ) With telling a lie, Shubhash also tried to justify it.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Besides telling a lie, Shubhash also tried to justify it.
English Wizard.exp:
not only ..... but also এর পরিবর্তে Simple Sentence এ besides বসে।
(খ) এবং (ঘ) উভয়টাতে besides থাকলেও (খ)-তে Shubhash – Noun টা নেই, তাই এটা ভুল।
তাই সঠিক উত্তর (ঘ)।

English Wizard.question: ২) The moon rose up and all the villagers gathered under the banyan tree. (Make it complex)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Since the moon rose up, all the villagers gathered under the banyan tree.
English Wizard.option2: খ) As the moon rose up, all the villagers gathered under the banyan tree.
English Wizard.option3: গ) The moon rose up so that all the villagers gathered under the banyan tree.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) After the moon rose up, all the villagers gathered under the banyan tree.
English Wizard.exp:
প্রথম Clause দিয়ে ২য় Clause এর সময় বুঝাচ্ছে। তাই Complex Sentence এ When/As (যখন) ব্যবহৃত হবে। এ হিসেবে সঠিক উত্তর (খ)।
After দিয়ে সময় বুঝালেও After এর পরে নিয়ম অনুযায়ী Past Perfect Tense হওয়ার কথা।
কিন্তু এখানে Past Indefinite Tense আছে, তাই এটা সঠিক উত্তর হবে না।

English Wizard.question: ৩) I saw a snake and it was terrible to look at. (Make it simple)
English Wizard.option1: ক) I saw a snake to look at terrible.
English Wizard.option2: খ) I saw to look at a terrible snake.
English Wizard.option3: গ) I saw a snake terrible to look at.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) I saw a terrible snake to look at.
English Wizard.exp: Terrible to look at একটা Adjective Phrase. Adjective Phrase – Noun এর পরে বসে Noun কে Modify করে। এ হিসেবে সঠিক উত্তর (গ)।

English Wizard.question: ৪) He worked hard and brought prosperity to his family. (Make it Complex)
English Wizard.option1: ক) If he worked hard, he could bring prosperity to his family.
English Wizard.option2: খ) If he worked hard, he brought prosperity to his family.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Since he worked hard, he brought prosperity to his family.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He worked hard so that he could bring prosperity to his family.
English Wizard.exp:
প্রথম Clause টা ২য় Clause এর কারণ বুঝাচ্ছে।
অর্থাৎ কঠোর পরিশ্রম করার কারণেই সে তার পরিবারে উন্নতি আনতে পেরেছিল।
তাই এখানে যেহেতু অর্থে Since বসবে।

English Wizard.question: ৫) The thief entered my room and at that very moment I woke up. (Make it Complex)
English Wizard.option1: ক) When the thief entered my room, I woke up.
English Wizard.option2: খ) If the thief entered my room, I woke up.
English Wizard.option3: গ) After the thief entered my room, I woke up.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) As soon as the thief entered my room, I woke up.
English Wizard.exp: Compound Sentence এ and at that very moment (এবং ঠিক ঐ মুহুর্তেই) থাকলে Complex Sentence এ As soon as (করতে না করতেই/ হতে না হতেই) বসে।

English Wizard.question: ৬) He sacrificed everything for his sons but received nothing in return. (Make it simple)
English Wizard.option1: ক) In spite sacrificing everything for his sons, he received nothing in return.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Despite of sacrificing everything for his sons, he received nothing in return.
English Wizard.option3: গ) In spite of sacrificing everything for his sons, he received nothing in return.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Besides sacrificing everything for his sons, he received nothing in return.
English Wizard.exp:
Compound Sentence এ but থাকলে Simple Sentence এ in spite of/ despite/ notwithstanding বসে।
(ক) তে in spite এর পর of নেই। (খ) তে despite এর পরে of এসেছে। তাই সঠিক উত্তর কেবল (গ)।

English Wizard.question: ৭) Fight confidently, otherwise you cannot defeat them. (Make complex)
English Wizard.option1: ক) If you fight confidently, you cannot defeat them.
English Wizard.option2: খ) If you not fight confidently, you cannot defeat them.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Unless you fight confidently, you cannot defeat them.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Unless you don’t fight confidently, you cannot defeat them.
English Wizard.exp:
Imperative Sentence এর পর or/ otherwise থাকলে Complex Sentence এ If not/ Unless বসে।
Unless নিজেই negative হওয়ায় এর পর আর কোনো no/not ইত্যাদি বসানো যাবে না।

English Wizard.question: ৮) Help the distressed and Allah will help you. (Make it simple)
English Wizard.option1: ক) If you help the distressed, Allah will help you.
English Wizard.option2: খ) As you help the distressed, Allah will help you.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Help the distressed for Allah will help you.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Unless you help the distressed, Allah will help you.
English Wizard.exp:
প্রশ্নের ইনস্ট্রাকশনে ভুল ছিলো।
Make it simple এর স্থলে Make it complex হলে অপশন ক) ঠিক ছিলো।
উত্তর বাতিল করা হয়েছে।

- Imperative Sentence + and থাকলে Complex Sentence এ If যোগ হয়।

English Wizard.question: ৯) As soon as the boy finished his tragical story, Juber decided to help him. (Make it negative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) As soon as the boy did not start his tragical story, Juber decided to help him.
English Wizard.option2: খ) No sooner the boy had finished his tragical story, Juber decided to help him.
English Wizard.option3: গ) No sooner had the boy finished his tragical story, Juber decided to help him.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) No sooner had the boy finished his tragical story than Juber decided to help him.
English Wizard.exp: Affirmative Sentence এ As soon as থাকলে Negative Sentence এ No sooner had + Subject + Past Participle of the verb (+Extension)+ than + ২য় Clause বসে।

English Wizard.question: ১০) A rose has a thorn. (Make it negative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) There is no rose but a thorn.
English Wizard.option2: খ) There is no rose without have a thorn.
English Wizard.option3: গ) There is no rose which has a thorn.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) There is no rose but has a thorn.
English Wizard.exp:
জাতিবাজক a/an থাকলে negative করার সময় সাধারণত Structure হয়:
i)    There is no + Subject + but + Verb + Object/ Extension
ii)    There is no + Subject + which does not + Verb + Object/ Extension

যখন Verb হিসেবে have/has থাকে, তখন পূর্বোক্তভাবেও করা যায়  অথবা এভাবেও করা যায় - 
iii)    There is no + Subject + without + (Object)/ (having + Object)

এখানে কেবল প্রথম Structure অনুযায়ী শুধু (ঘ) সঠিকভাবে ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।

English Wizard.question: ১১) We had to go there. (Make it negative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) We could not but going there.
English Wizard.option2: খ) We must not go there.
English Wizard.option3: গ) We could not help going there.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) We had not to help going there.
English Wizard.exp:
must/ have to থাকলে negative করতে হলে Structure হচ্ছে -
i)    cannot but + verb এর base form
ii)    cannot help + verb+ing
একই ভাবে had to থাকলে –
iii)    could not but + verb এর base form
iv)    could not help + verb+ing

English Wizard.question: ১২) Only Rana can say so. (make it negative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) None but Rana cannot say so.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Rana cannot but say so.
English Wizard.option3: গ) None but Rana can say so.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Rana alone cannot say so.
English Wizard.exp:
Only দিয়ে ব্যক্তিকে নির্দেশ করলে, Negative করতে হলে Only এর পরিবর্তে None but বসে।
আর Only দিয়ে বস্তু বা ধারণাকে নির্দেশ করলে, Negative করতে হলে Only এর পরিবর্তে Nothing but বসে।
আর Only দিয়ে বয়স/ সংখ্যা ইত্যাদি নির্দেশ করলে, Negative করতে হলে Only এর পরিবর্তে Not more than বসে।

English Wizard.question: ১৩) It is found nowhere but in Egypt. (make it affirmative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) It is found everywhere but in Egypt.
English Wizard.option2: খ) It is found only in Egypt.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Only it is found in Egypt
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) It is alone found in Egypt.
English Wizard.exp:
বাক্যে nowhere but থাকলে Affirmative এ only বসবে এবং এটা স্থানকে Modify করবে। 
গ- তে only – It কে Modify করছে। তাই সঠিক উত্তর কেবল (খ)।

English Wizard.question: ১৪) He was too naive to understand the lie. (make it negative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) He was so naive not to understand the lie.
English Wizard.option2: খ) He was so naive that he cannot understand the lie.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He was naive so that he could not understand the lie.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He was so naive that he could not understand the lie.
English Wizard.exp:
too ...... to থাকলে Negative করার সময় so ..... that বসে। 
প্রথম Clause এ was থাকায় ২য় Clause এ could not বসবে।

English Wizard.question: ১৫) Snow is not whiter than ice. (Make it Affirmative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Snow is as white as snow.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Ice is whiter than snow.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Ice is as white as snow.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Ice is less white than snow.
English Wizard.exp:
Comparative Degree কে Positive Degree তে রূপান্তর করে Affirmative করতে হয়। এ ক্ষেত্রে ৪টি কাজ করতে হবে: 
১. Object – Subject হবে, Subject টা Object হবে। (Ice--> snow, snow --> ice)
২. not বাদ যাবে। 
৩. degree change হবে। (whiter --> white) 
৪. Indicator Change হবে। ( than –->  as ....as)

English Wizard.question: ১৬) There is no student in the class who will not get A+ in the exam. (Make it Affirmative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) There is a student in the class who will get A+ in the exam.
English Wizard.option2: খ) There are many students in the class who will get A+ in the exam.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Every student in the class will get A+ in the exam.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) A student in the class will get A+ in the exam.
English Wizard.exp:
There is no (Noun) ........ who থাকলে Affirmative করতে হলে Every + (Noun) .......... বসে।
ক্লাসে এমন কোনো শিক্ষার্থী নেই যে A+ পাবে না। অর্থাৎ - প্রত্যেক শিক্ষার্থীই A+ পাবে।

English Wizard.question: ১৭) He is through and through a wicked person. Here ‘through and through’ means –
English Wizard.option1: ক) perhaps
English Wizard.option2: খ) entirely
English Wizard.option3: গ) to some extent
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) surprisingly
English Wizard.exp: through and through = সম্পূর্ণভাবে = entirely

English Wizard.question: ১৮) ‘Yellow dog’ means –
English Wizard.option1: ক) coward
English Wizard.option2: খ) prejudiced
English Wizard.option3: গ) weak
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) unnatural
English Wizard.exp: Yellow dog = ভীরু, কাপুরুষ = coward

English Wizard.question: ১৯) ‘Taste of your own medicine’ means –
English Wizard.option1: ক) to help yourself
English Wizard.option2: খ) tit for tat
English Wizard.option3: গ) something happens to you that you have done to someone else
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) enjoy leave without permission and suffer the consequences
English Wizard.exp: Taste of your own medicine = তুমি অন্য কারো সাথে যা করেছ তোমার প্রতিও একই রকম হওয়া = something happens to you that you have done to someone else

English Wizard.question: ২০) ‘See eye to eye’ means –
English Wizard.option1: ক) become angry with another person
English Wizard.option2: খ) help each other
English Wizard.option3: গ) agree on something with another person
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) become satisfied with another person
English Wizard.exp: See eye to eye = কোনো ব্যাপারে কারো সাথে একমত হওয়া = agree on something with another person

English Wizard.question: ২১) He will do the work if it becomes worth his while. Here ‘worth his while’ means-
English Wizard.option1: ক) beneficial
English Wizard.option2: খ) sustainable
English Wizard.option3: গ) easy
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) timely
English Wizard.exp: worth his while = উপকারী, লাভজনক = beneficial

English Wizard.question: ২২) ‘Throw cold water’ means –
English Wizard.option1: ক) inspire
English Wizard.option2: খ) calm down
English Wizard.option3: গ) dishearten
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) reject
English Wizard.exp: Throw cold water = নিরুৎসাহিত করা = dishearten

English Wizard.question: ২৩) ‘Take one to task’ means –
English Wizard.option1: ক) make responsible
English Wizard.option2: খ) take action for someone
English Wizard.option3: গ) rebuke
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) look after
English Wizard.exp: Take one to task = ভর্ৎসনা করা, তিরস্কার করা = rebuke

English Wizard.question: ২৪) ‘Red-handed’ means –
English Wizard.option1: ক) while doing something wrong or illegal
English Wizard.option2: খ) specially arranged
English Wizard.option3: গ) hand-made
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) skillfully
English Wizard.exp: Red-handed = হাতে-নাতে = while doing something wrong or illegal

English Wizard.question: ২৫) ‘Make up for’ means –
English Wizard.option1: ক) conjecture
English Wizard.option2: খ) compensate
English Wizard.option3: গ) return
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) organise
English Wizard.exp: make up for = ক্ষতিপূরণ করা = compensate
